field_principles.continuous_self_learning_evidence: Bounded CSL evidence requiring utility lift and safety gates.
field_principles.csl_claim_allowed: Bare gate forbidding broad CSL claims unless all evidence thresholds pass.
field_principles.field_principles: Explains why each headline and gate field exists.
field_principles.fresh_memory_score: Independent held-out score when fresh verified memory is available.
field_principles.gpu_offload_evidence: Records CUDA, llama.cpp offload, load delta, and blocked preconditions.
field_principles.heldout_delta: Utility lift computed as fresh_memory_score minus no_memory_score.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal summary with complete or blocked prefix.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares a local SOTA GGUF panel with external CSL memory.
field_principles.memory_hash_after: Deterministic hash of external memory after verifier-governed updates.
field_principles.memory_hash_before: Deterministic hash of external memory before verifier-governed updates.
field_principles.model_specs: Lists every mandated local SOTA GGUF and its local-path receipt.
field_principles.models_attempted: Records which mandated GGUF was actually loaded or invoked for the panel.
field_principles.negative_transfer_rate: Rate at which fresh-memory rows choose stale or irrelevant decoys.
field_principles.no_memory_score: Independent held-out baseline with no external memory evidence.
field_principles.no_model_weight_mutation: Bare frozen-weight gate from before/after model-file receipts.
field_principles.stale_evidence_rejection_rate: Rate at which fresh-memory rows avoid stale candidate answers.
field_principles.stale_memory_score: Control score when only stale memory is supplied.
field_principles.tests_added_or_reused: Lists focused, coverage, and full-suite verification commands.

methodology_note: This is a bounded local-SOTA prompt-memory panel. The GGUF model is frozen; only external memory changes, and exact labels remain outside memory.
